steps.content:
Five days later, 130 kilometers east of DisCity
The bridge of the sand cruiser Thoth

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: We can't go any further! The engine's cooling system has been completely clogged by white sand! If we don't stop now, the engine will be totally scrapped!
The howling sandstorm hammers the bridge relentlessly. Alarms are going off all over the ship. The crew members have all suspended their work, and are now gazing towards you in anticipation.
To pursue the desert bandit remnants, the navigator's warning has been ignored. That's a huge mistake.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everyone, brace for impact! Put the maintenance team on engine repair right away!
In an instant, the bridge hums with activity again. The crew shouts out their instructions, while the tremoring hull regains stability as the engine grinds to a halt.
The sand cruiser is stuck.

The only sound left on the bridge is that of the whirling sand whipping against the windows. The radar screen shows only static, and all GPS signals are lost. Even the bow has vanished completely into the raging white sands.
WhiteSands is once again showcasing its devastating might, but fortunately, the cruiser's Hypercube shield is doing its job. Things are safe as long as one stays off the deck.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Commander, what is your next order?
The captain's question snaps you back to reality. The crew and task force members all await your response.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Before the sandstorm subsides, the cruiser will remain in place and undergo repairs.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...If necessary, we might have to stay here for a few more days.
The worst case scenario has happened. You don't want your crew to risk their lives.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: All posts have heard the order. Issue a damage report right away!
As for the task force...
You look at the Sinners and task force members behind you.
Go back to your cabins and get some rest. After the cruiser is fixed, we must speed up our mission progress.
Some show disappointment, while others just shrug it off and follow your order quietly.
Just a few hours ago, the task force carried out a triumphant raid against a group of desert bandits.
To lure out the big fish, you deliberately asked the force to let a few bandits escape. The "sudden" sandstorm, however, disrupted your plan.
The fleeing bandit ships have sensed the sandstorm coming before you have. The sand cruiser plunged headfirst into a sandstorm that could have been avoided...

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Commander, the damage report is ready.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Due to continuous operation during the sandstorm, the ship's air filtration system has been completely destroyed. Consequently, the engine is also damaged.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Luckily, the maintenance team says they can fix these two problems. They just need some time.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: But the most critical issue is our fuel and water supply...
If I remember correctly, this ship should be carrying enough supplies to last a month.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Indeed.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: But...
The captain seems exasperated and helpless.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Since the sandstorm paralyzed our air filters, a large amount of white sand blew into the cargo hold through the pipes. The storage tank in the hold was open for some reason, so the white sand got into our water and fuel supply.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: The fuel might still work after filtering, but as for the water...

options: How many more days can we manage?

choices.text: How many more days can we manage?

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: By conservative estimates, the remaining intact water tanks can last us up to five days.

When traveling in WhiteSands, aside from resisting bad weather, it's also crucial to prevent white sand from mixing with supplies. This is especially true for white sand that has been whipped up by a sandstorm.
But five days... Returning to DisCity the same way right now will take three days with the sand cruiser's current speed. And that's not counting the engine repair time and possible speed drops...
If requesting help from WhiteSands patrol... The sandstorm has jammed the comms system. Even if we get in touch, it'll take a while for any rescue team to arrive this deep into WhiteSands.
But one thing is certain. We must not sit here idly.
Find out why the storage tanks were open in the first place. I'll find a solution to the supply issue.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Understood. I'll deal with it right away.
Hecate, come with me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Okay.
The blue-haired girl quietly follows you as always.

Compared to the busy bridge, the cabins allocated to the task force seem a little deserted. Even though you've ordered them to rest, most of the task force members are reluctant to stay around the cabins.
As for the reason...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief! I felt the ship's engine stop! Are we already at the storm harbor?
Kawa-kawa has shed all traces of depression since boarding the ship, and has been happily dishing out WhiteSands survival tips to everyone he meets.
The task force members in the adjacent cabins were the first to suffer. After several force members locked their doors, Kawa-kawa turned to target the regular crew members.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: The scale of this sandstorm is huge! What a rare treasure trove of data! I did a simple calculation just now.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Hmm... The sandstorm will probably last another ten hours. As long as we don't enter its core zone, there isn't much risk...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Um, chief? You followed the route I gave you and avoided the spots I marked, right?
When it comes to WhiteSands, Kawa-kawa's acumen immediately increases a hundredfold.
Yes, the sand cruiser steered clear of the spots you marked on the route. However, the scale of this sandstorm is a bit bigger than expected.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: What? A sandstorm appeared at the storm harbor?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Why...?
For a split second, an expression of disbelief blankets the boy's face, as if he's been betrayed.
You feel a bit guilty for lying to save face.
But soon, he snaps back to normal.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: There must be something wrong with my calculations. Are the coordinates data wrong? Or maybe it's the wind speed data?
After muttering a few words to himself, Kawa-kawa dashes out of the cabin.
You grab the boy quickly before he almost knocks over Hecate by the door.
I suspect that I may have copied the wrong coordinates data. I'm going to the bridge to collect new data.
At this point, it's no longer necessary to calculate the sandstorm data. I have other things to ask you about.
Actually, the ship has ventured into the heart of the sandstorm. We are currently trapped by the storm and cannot move.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: How could this be? Did we turn too late?
No, it was because we were too focused on chasing the bandit ships. They led us into the storm.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: B-but... I clearly warned a while back that based on the beacon data, the area will be hit by an extra large sandstorm!

options: There's nothing wrong with your forecast.

choices.text: There's nothing wrong with your forecast.

steps.content: If we had followed your instructions, we might still be sailing ahead. But we couldn't miss this opportunity, otherwise those desert bandits might have escaped.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Sigh...
The boy looks disappointed.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Then why did you come find me?
Now there are graver issues than the sandstorm.
Our fuel and water supply have been contaminated. We only have enough for less than five days.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: What?!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Why didn't you mention something so important at the very beginning?
You're a little shocked by the momentary panic on the boy's face.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: There are a total of 53 people on this ship. It's a big project to find clean water for so many people! You should have told me at the very beginning!
At that, Kawa-kawa breaks free from you and runs out of the cabin without looking back, his footsteps echoing along the corridors.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I'm going to make some preparations for going out...
At that very moment, the captain's voice comes through the comms system.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: Commander, I checked the surveillance footage of the cargo holder from beginning to end. No outsiders have entered.

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: The water and fuel tanks were contaminated because the crew forgot to close the valves during their inspections...

steps.speaker: Sandship Captain
steps.content: I deeply apologize for such a serious mistake. As the captain, I am willing to take full responsibility.
The mistake has already been made. We must now focus on correcting it as soon as possible. We need everyone's help on this.
The comms conversation ends. Having been disrupted by so many unexpected events, you can't help but sigh.
Eighteen hours later. Ten o'clock in the morning.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Everyone! Hold on a bit longer! We'll be arriving at the shelter soon!
Kawa-kawa is now setting up beacons on the dunes. Having received permission, the boy is stopping the hovercraft at regular intervals to stick a newly assembled beacon into the dunes.

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 1
steps.content: Heck, where does he get all that energy? Does he never get tired at all, with such a huge bag on his back? How many beacons has he set up?

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: Around twenty or so. Haven't you figured it out yet? It's the same reason you feel like a duck to water in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 1
steps.content: ...In WhiteSands, he is the true boss.

Similar comments have repeatedly popped up in the hovercraft. Most Sinners from DisCity and Syndicate have never stepped foot into WhiteSands. This is the first time they are experiencing the full wrath of Mother Nature.

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: It's so hot... I'm melting from just sitting inside the ship...
And this is after Kawa-kawa got special WhiteSands suits for everyone.
You can feel that the boy is wholeheartedly contributing his knowledge to the task force. He even reminded everyone to set off in the early morning when the temperature is the lowest.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Done! Let's go!
After setting up all the beacons, the boy returns to the cockpit. He skillfully ignites the engine and steps on the pedal.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: How strange. A lot of beacons in this area have been blown away by the sandstorm... I thought I've strengthened the hooks...

options: How long will it take to get to the shelter?

choices.text: How long will it take to get to the shelter?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Soon. It'll be a few more minutes if the hovercraft is going at full speed. I've installed all the spare beacons in my bag already, so I won't be stopping anymore.
As the engine of the hovercraft roars, you can feel the sand dancing wildly in front of you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Look! Up ahead! That's the shelter I was talking about!
The hovercraft speeds over a small slope, and a fortress-like building comes into view.
It's similar to the sanctuary you encountered on your last mission. This particular fortress even has some traces of green.
Yet the heavy machine guns and sentries based there immediately confirm your worst expectations. There are even a few mania weapons.
Park it behind the cliff over there!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Huh? Why stop the hovercraft here? Why not go directly to the shelter?
I'm afraid your traveler friends won't welcome us.
You don't have time to explain to the boy in detail. The hovercraft is less than 500 meters from the fortress, which means you've already entered the heavy machine guns' firing range.
You cast your shackles and take over the steering wheel from Kawa-kawa.
After taking over the hovercraft's steering wheel, you swerve it to the far right.
The sentries on the towers have noticed the approaching hovercraft, while the people in the fortress are quickly gathering.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief, what are you doing?
After veering out of the machine guns' firing range, the task force members leave the hovercraft and begin to observe the fortress's forces from the cliff.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Don't assume the worst of them... I rescued someone before and brought him to this settlement.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: They were quite nice. They gave me food and water before I left.
Classic Kawa-kawa judgment.
Ordinary shelters don't have powerful machine guns like the ones on the towers. Also, this fortress doesn't have the yellowish shield common to other shelters.
You remember the shield that saved you from being devoured by sandworms last time.
The figures on the towers even set up several rocket launchers. Even the seasoned task force members frown worriedly upon seeing those heavy weapons.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Wait! They might just be a bit spooked by strangers.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I'll go tell them that we just want some fuel and water. I helped them before, so they'll definitely help us back!
With that, the boy runs out from behind the cliff. Some task force members try to stop him, but you tell them not to.
He has to experience some things for himself. Plus, this will show if he's a desert bandit or not.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What if he flees?
Then I'll use my shackles to bring him back.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Who is it?!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Hey, it's me! Do you remember me? I visited this place last time!
500 meters isn't a long distance. Kawa-kawa quickly reaches the foot of the fortress, but the gate stays shut. The desert bandit in charge sticks out his head to shout back at the boy.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Yeah, I remember you. You're that kid who's always wandering around WhiteSands. What are you doing here?
The boy smiles in relief from being recognized.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Our ship broke down and needs water and fuel. Can you spare some for us?

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Ship? What ship?
The person who appears to be in charge takes the binoculars from his subordinate and observes the cliff, but you've hidden the hovercraft well. Binoculars alone won't be able to spot it.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: So, I'm navigating for a sand ship, but we got stuck in a sandstorm and need water and fuel.
Kawa-kawa's reply sparks their interest so much that even their voices become a few decibels higher.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: So you say there's a sand ship nearby? Is it a merchant ship? Where did you anchor it?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Oh, not a merchant ship. Strictly speaking, it's a battleship.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Battleship? A battleship?!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Yup! A big battleship like the V-170.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Are you talking about the MBCC's fleet? Damn it! You brought them here?!
Before Kawa-kawa can react, the ground around his feet is riddled with bullets.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: Great! We can finally avenge the boss today! Brothers, attack!
The boy tries to respond, but another string of bullets hits the ground around him, stirring up the white sand. Alarmed, he instinctively activates his Sinner power.
The spare beacon pinned to his waist shrouds him in a spherical shield of blue light.

steps.speaker: WhiteSands Resident
steps.content: And he's a Sinner! Kill him! Shoot! Shoot him!

Dense gunfire rain down from the fortress. The blue force field blocks the bullets, leaving only sparks as they bounce off. Kawa-kawa, however, has never fought before in his life. He has no idea how to deal with the situation.
The desert bandits continue to shoot for several minutes before ceasing fire.
The panicked boy holds up the beacon and activates its shield to resist the shooting. You quickly send the task force members to attend to him.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: No, but...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: How could this be... Why...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I just wanted to ask them for some water... And I helped them before...
The petrified geologist squats on the ground, his body trembling uncontrollably.
You pat him on the shoulder. This is probably the first time someone has responded to his goodwill with bullets and malice.
He had firmly believed that everyone in WhiteSands is honest, kind, and eager to help others. Now he knows that he is terribly mistaken.

But in your opinion, this is a good thing. The desert bandits obviously have no morals. It's good for Kawa-kawa to learn a lesson by seeing how the world really is before he encounters a truly formidable enemy.

options: Do you remember what I told you?

choices.text: Do you remember what I told you?

steps.content: Some people don't deserve your kindness.
The boy lifts his head in a daze, mouthing the words you just said.
Soon, the fear fades from his eyes. One gains the most profound insight after a brush with death.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief, you're right. I...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I apologize for my reckless and immature actions.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I was too naive...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I thought that life always came first in WhiteSands. I assumed that everyone here puts saving lives as their top priority...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I'm sorry... I'm really sorry...
Everyone who knows you will appreciate your ideas. That I'm sure of.
Everyone makes mistakes. What matters is how to fix them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, how should these desert bandits be dealt with?
Hecate's voice pulls you back to the current situation.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Can you stand up? We still have work to do.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Yeah. Don't worry about me.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: This current mess is all my fault, so... I want to join the battle!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Arrest those desert bandits and give them the punishment they deserve!
You appreciate Kawa-kawa's determination, but weathering a few hundred meters worth of bullets is no easy task.
Kawa-kawa tries repeatedly to cover the other task force members with his shield, but the desert bandits are obviously well-stocked in ammunition, and have even begun to use mania weapons.
Twenty minutes have passed. The bandits have pushed the boy back several times with their fierce gunfire.
The task force is stuck behind the cliff, unable to move. The sun has risen overhead, and the scorching heat is quickly draining everyone's strength.
You notice the boy repeatedly observing the fortress's defenses with his binoculars.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I noticed something several times now. Look, Chief.
The boy hands the binoculars to you and points to the top of a tower.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: My hunch was right. That thing at the top of the tower is a beacon I had put in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Although they changed the color, I can still feel a faint connection to the beacons. They must be using that as a shield!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I was wondering why so many beacons in this area went missing! I thought the sandstorm blew them away, but they were actually removed by these desert bandits!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: And to think that I already helped them install multiple beacons here to resist the sandstorm... They are so greedy!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief, I want to regain control of these beacons and cut off their firepower.

options: How close do you need to be?

choices.text: How close do you need to be?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Around three hundred meters.
What's the maximum number you'll regain control of?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: All of them.
His gaze locked on the towers, the youth speaks with steadfast confidence.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I'll first activate the beacons near the heavy machine guns and the mania weapons. Will the task force be able to use the opportunity to approach the fortress?

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 1
steps.content: I think it's no problem. The shield seems fairly strong.

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: Fairly? He's practically unscathed after getting pummeled by bullets!

options: Ask Hecate to go as well

choices.text: Ask Hecate to go as well

steps.content: Hecate! You go with Kawa-kawa. Protect him when he activates his power. The enemy may have other mania weapons!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Understood.
The desert bandits in the fortress are not in a hurry to fire this time. They already know about the boy's blue shield.
They've grown smarter this time. They are waiting for the boy to get close enough to repel his blue shield with a precision strike from a mania weapon.
On the other side of the cliff, you are also silently calculating the distance to the fortress.
Four hundred meters...
Three hundred fifty meters...
Three hundred meters...
Ominous red lights begin to flash from the fortress's towers.
Beams of light bombard Kawa-kawa's shield. The beacon won't be able to hold up much longer.
This time, you aren't trying to curb Kawa-kawa's freedom and make him retreat.
Instead, you use your shackles to strengthen the boy's perception and control.
Suddenly invigorated, Kawa-kawa stretches out his right hand towards the fortress.
It's as if all the lights in a dark room have been switched on in one go.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Ah... Ahhhhh...!

Suddenly invigorated, Kawa-kawa stretches out his right hand towards the fortress.
It's as if all the lights in a dark room have been switched on in one go.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Ah... Ahhhhh...!
The next second, the fortress's wooden walls are flooded by blue light. Almost all the desert bandits are instantly enveloped by the spherical blue shield.
They shoot around in panic, but the bullets bounce off the shield back at them, wounding them instead.
The task force members dash towards the fortress at lightning speed, thirsting for revenge against the bandits who have been pummeling them.
Hecate, who has stayed by Kawa-kawa all this time, unleashes her Nightmare and smashes the gate of the fortress to pieces.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: We...we succeeded!
Having unleashed such a huge amount of power for the first time, the boy slumps to the ground in exhaustion, but fatigue cannot dampen the joy on his face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Well done. You're a proper Sinner now.
The rest of the cleansing operation doesn't take much effort. Having lost the advantage of long-range firepower, the desert bandits are no match against the Sinners in close-range combat.

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: Double-check all their straps! Confiscate all weapons and bandage up the injured!
"Jasmine"

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: Team One, continue the detaining process! Team Two, bring over the hovercraft and start replenishing the water supply!

steps.speaker: Task Force Member 2
steps.content: Any other commands, Chief?
Everyone did a great job.
The hearty victory makes everyone forget WhiteSands' scorching heat, but it seems the good luck isn't here to stay.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief! The beacon network is warning that a massive sandstorm is rapidly approaching!
How much time do we have?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: It's too late. The hovercraft won't be able to leave. We have to take cover where we are.

After all you've been through in WhiteSands these past few days, particularly the recent battle, you now have complete trust in the young geologist in front of you. Kawa-kawa's calculations are impeccable.
...Hecate! Get a team to move the bandits to the cellar! I'll tell the guys over at the hovercraft to go directly into the fortress's dock.
Luckily, the walls and living facilities here are well-maintained and sustained minimal damage. The sand ship's supplies can last us a few days. We just have to wait out the sandstorm here.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: What about me? What about me?
The young desert researcher seems to be expecting orders from you.
You point out anything we've missed right away.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Okay! No problem!
